name: OpenPort Verifiable Safe Tool Routing Profile v0.1
summary: Executable reference profile for server-computed safe routing sets, ranker non-expansion, current-state revalidation, scoped route records, and privacy-minimized route evidence.
claimBoundary: This profile validates the OpenPort reference routing contract. It does not certify model robustness, tool implementation safety, production hardening, or prompt-injection immunity.

checks.description: The route service MUST intersect retrieved candidates with current server-side authorization, intent, context, and registered-tool state before accepting a proposal.
evidence: safe tool set is a subset of submitted candidates

checks.description: A proposed tool outside the current safe routing set MUST be rejected with agent.route_selection_outside_safe_set and MUST NOT create an accepted route decision.
A route that becomes ineligible after current context or policy narrows MUST fail revalidation with agent.route_snapshot_stale.
evidence: route accepted under initial trusted context

checks.description: Route records MUST be scoped to app, key, and actor; cross-key reuse MUST be indistinguishable from a missing route.
evidence: HTTP 404 response under a different key

checks.description: Route audit MUST retain structurally complete include/exclude evidence without storing raw request text or raw unknown candidate identifiers.
evidence: one hashed evidence item per candidate
